description: Who pays for Celestia Fibre blockspace and how much: blobs settled, bytes, fees in TIA, blob size distribution, the on-chain fee formula and Cumulo's check of every charge against it, the publishers (accounts that pay) with their share of bytes and fees, price per MiB, escrow balances and withdrawals, the namespaces posting data, and blob activity over time. From Cumulo's open Fibre Network Monitor on the Mocha testnet (mocha-5); testnet TIA, not a mainnet price. Choose the period: 24h, 7d, 30d or all. Give an account (celestia1...) to see one publisher live: its blobs, namespaces, escrow deposits and withdrawals. Namespace names are bytes chosen by the publisher and marked untrusted. For individual blobs use list_fibre_blobs; for validators use get_fibre_validator.

account.description: A publisher account (celestia1...); gives that publisher live from Cumulo

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)
